title: Gideon and the Wreck
author: Hazel Oyelaran
blurb: Gideon Blackwood, a mountain guide blacklisted from two countries, keeps moving because stopping costs more. Then the tide reveals a cave that legends charge admission to — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must follow a river upstream to its forbidden source before the glacier calving season opens the route — briefly.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
